CREATE TABLE hiring_corrections (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,brand_id TEXT NOT NULL,application_id TEXT NOT NULL,candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,rights_version INTEGER NOT NULL,application_version INTEGER NOT NULL,field TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(field IN ('name','email','phone','contact_context')),previous_value TEXT,new_value TEXT NOT NULL,reason_reference TEXT NOT NULL,actor_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(application_id,organization_id,brand_id) REFERENCES hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id)); CREATE TABLE hiring_rectification_targets (correction_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hiring_corrections(id),processor_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(correction_id,processor_id)); CREATE TABLE hiring_rectification_attempts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,correction_id TEXT NOT NULL,processor_id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('complete','failed','unknown')),evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL,actor_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(correction_id,processor_id,version),FOREIGN KEY(correction_id,processor_id) REFERENCES hiring_rectification_targets(correction_id,processor_id)); CREATE TRIGGER hiring_correction_commit AFTER INSERT ON hiring_corrections BEGIN UPDATE hiring_candidates SET name=CASE WHEN NEW.field='name' THEN NEW.new_value ELSE name END,email=CASE WHEN NEW.field='email' THEN NEW.new_value ELSE email END,phone=CASE WHEN NEW.field='phone' THEN NEW.new_value ELSE phone END WHERE id=NEW.candidate_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND brand_id=NEW.brand_id; UPDATE hiring_applications SET contact_context=CASE WHEN NEW.field='contact_context' THEN NEW.new_value ELSE contact_context END,version=version+1,updated_at=NEW.created_at WHERE id=NEW.application_id AND organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND brand_id=NEW.brand_id; INSERT INTO hiring_rectification_targets SELECT NEW.id,'MAIL'; INSERT INTO hiring_rectification_targets SELECT NEW.id,processor_id FROM hiring_rectification_processors WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND brand_id=NEW.brand_id AND processor_id<>'MAIL'; INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) VALUES(NEW.id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.brand_id,NEW.application_id,'privacy.correction.applied',NEW.actor_user_id,NEW.id,NEW.created_at,NEW.request_id,'correction',NEW.id,'Verified field correction; submitted evidence preserved'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_rectification_audit AFTER INSERT ON hiring_rectification_attempts BEGIN INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT NEW.id,c.organization_id,c.brand_id,c.application_id,'privacy.rectification.'||NEW.state,NEW.actor_user_id,NEW.id,NEW.created_at,c.request_id,'correction',c.id,'Processor rectification outcome' FROM hiring_corrections c WHERE c.id=NEW.correction_id; END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_corrections_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON hiring_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_corrections_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON hiring_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_rectification_targets_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON hiring_rectification_targets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_rectification_targets_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON hiring_rectification_targets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_rectification_attempts_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON hiring_rectification_attempts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_rectification_attempts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON hiring_rectification_attempts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_rectification_processors_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON hiring_rectification_processors BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_rectification_processors_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON hiring_rectification_processors BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rectification evidence is append-only'); END;
